exact_frontier.theorem: For every feasible h, (C_A,C_F)=(h,min(m,F_b(n,h))) is constructively attainable.
exact_frontier.mechanism: protected deepest child-0 spine plus private opposite-target pairs

sharp_lift.general_form: max[U(C_A)-U(C_F)] = max_h[U(h)-U(I_h)] for finite nonincreasing U

interpretation.main: Natural history re-ranks an exact finite structural frontier; the ratio-optimal architecture need not maximize biological value.
interpretation.correction: Unbounded C_F/C_A does not imply unbounded fitness value.
interpretation.comparator_ceiling: The result is relative to the declared universal fixed comparator unless another architecture class is modeled.

prior_art_boundary.candidate_distinctive_result: sharp composition of the fixed-(n,m,b) guaranteed-resolution frontier with arbitrary monotone completion value, attained by the same constructive witnesses

claim_ceiling: The core sharp frontier and opportunity envelope are green at the recorded CI commit. Later general monotone-value and interpretive extensions should still be required to pass the latest branch CI before manuscript promotion.
